message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to currency exchange data, so I can only give you an approximate figure based on recent averages.

| Currency | Approximate Rate (as of late 2023/early 2024) |
|----------|----------------------------------------------|
| 1 USD    | 0.75 GBP (roughly)                           |

Using that rough average:

* **$20 × 0.75 GBP/USD ≈ £15**

So $20 is roughly equivalent to **£15**.  

Keep in mind that exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so the exact amount you receive will depend on the current market rate and any fees your bank or payment service may charge. If you need an up‑to‑date conversion, you can check a reliable financial news site, a currency‑conversion app, or your bank’s website.
